import fs from 'node:fs'

const J = process.argv[2]
const D = `/data/eval-m27b/jobs/${J}`
const job = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${D}/job.json`, 'utf8'))
const site = job.surface === 'site'
const vars = {
  JOB: J,
  SURFACE: job.surface,
  ROLE: site ? 'web developer' : 'product (console) developer',
  N: job.pages.length,
  SURFACE_LONG: site ? 'pages of the azion.com marketing site' : 'screens of the Azion console',
  DIR: D,
  FIRST: job.pages[0],
  THEME_RULE: site
    ? 'The site is **dark only**: every page renders in WebKit dark theme.'
    : 'The console is **light**: every screen renders in WebKit light theme.',
  PORT: job.port,
  SCHEME: site ? 'dark' : 'light',
  EXPAND: site ? '' : ' expand',
  PAGES: job.pages.map((p) => '`' + p + '`').join(', ')
}
let t = fs.readFileSync('/data/eval-m27b/bin/BRIEF.template.md', 'utf8')
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(vars)) t = t.replaceAll(`{{${k}}}`, String(v))
process.stdout.write(t)
